data.name: Vijaypal
data.gender_notes: Vijaypal is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Vijaypal is a compound name, where 'Vijay' means victory, and 'pal' means protector or friend. This name symbolizes a victorious and courageous individual who is a friend and protector to all. The name Vijaypal carries the meaning “Victory, Conqueror” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Vijaypal usually hope their child will grow to embody victory, conqueror and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Vijaypal is a name of Lord Vishnu, who is the preserver of the universe. It is believed that chanting this name bestows the blessings of Lord Vishnu and helps one overcome challenges and obstacles in life.
data.etymology: Vijaypal belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victory, Conqueror.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vijaypal total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
